newsitem.title: UK: Fleming Japanese to launch GDR programme.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Japanese to launch GDR programme.

text.p: Fleming Japanese Investment Trust Plc said on Friday it would launch a global depositary receipt (GDR) programme for its shares on March 24.

It said in a statement the launch, the first of its kind by an investment trust, would broaden its shareholder base and was designed for continental European, Far Eastern and other investors outside the U.S.

It said the programme would enable investors to buy the ordinary shares in the company using a dollar-denominated and separately quoted instrument. No new shares will be launched as a result of the programme.

In the year to end-September 1996 the trust had a net asset value of 615.5 million sterling and a portfolio consisting mainly of investments in manufacturing, financial services, consumer goods industries and utilities.
"...we believe the programme should attract a good deal of interest from continental European and Far Eastern institutional investors," FJIT chairman Patrick Gifford said.
